Callout.Name: Poaching Reported
Callout.Message: Shots heard on protected land after dark.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle parked at the treeline, no persons seen.

Script.Line: Shots after dark and a truck parked at the treeline.
That is not a target shooter. Not at this hour.
Assume they are armed. That would be my advice.

Lines.Approach: Shots after dark and a truck at the treeline. Take it slowly, they will have rifles.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
